name: beUI
summary: Free MIT accessible animated React components (beUI Pro templates/blocks excluded).
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry items of ~127 items in https://beui.dev/r/registry.json — not a full inventory.
Freemium: free MIT OSS at beui.dev / starc007/ui-components; beUI Pro at https://pro.beui.dev ($129 yearly / $179 lifetime premium blocks/templates) — Pro excluded; no paid unlock.
Some motion comps need @paper-design/shaders-react, lucide-react, and/or motion peers.
Text Scramble / Text Shimmer demos share the Text Animation docs page iframe.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.
Category paths vary: motion vs blocks (e.g. dynamic-island is blocks).

components.name: Tilt Card
components.summary: 3D perspective tilt on hover with cursor-tracked glare.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @beui/tilt-card

import { TiltCard } from "@/components/motion/tilt-card"

<TiltCard className="w-[280px] border p-8">Tilt me</TiltCard>

copyPrompt.text: Use beUI free component `Tilt Card` (slug `tilt-card`) from https://beui.dev/components/motion/tilt-card. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @beui/tilt-card` after `npx shadcn@latest init`. Registry item: https://beui.dev/r/tilt-card.json. Import path after CLI follows project aliases (see docs). Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; peers: Needs motion.. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starc007/ui-components/main/LICENSE). Free OSS motion/blocks registry on beui.dev; beUI Pro (https://pro.beui.dev, $129/yr or $179 lifetime) excluded — prefer free-tier only; do not unlock Pro.
